findings.evidence: Phase 2-6 used chronological folds; Phase 6 uses five folds and a one-session embargo.
Canonical target uses close[t+1]/close[t]-1 on the next available trading observation.
131 audited feature rows were classified SAFE with future_information_detected=False; this is source inspection, not formal proof.
No contamination was identified in the inspected research paths; full symbolic proof was not performed.
Models and previous-close baselines were compared on the same chronological validation observations within each experiment.
MAE, RMSE, MAPE where meaningful, and directional accuracy were reported; Phase 6 residual metrics use out-of-sample rows.
Phase 6 intervals use only prior out-of-sample residuals, but residual dependence and statistical significance were not tested.

discrepancies: Phase 5 baseline statistics use the full audited series, while Phase 6 uses five-fold out-of-sample rows; differing MAE/RMSE values are expected, not silently reconciled.
Phase 2-4 model summaries use their own experiment windows and feature sets; their aggregate metrics are not directly interchangeable.
